legal_terms_intro: Please read these Terms of Service carefully before using kmcheck.com.
legal_terms_s1_body: By accessing or using kmcheck.com ("the Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the Service. We reserve the right to update these terms at any time with notice posted on this page.
legal_terms_s2_body1: kmcheck provides Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) lookup and vehicle history report services. Reports are compiled from multiple independent third-party data sources, which may include auction marketplaces, insurance and claims databases, odometer registries, theft records, listing platforms, and other commercial data providers. kmcheck is an information aggregator and presentation service — we do not create primary vehicle records and we do not inspect vehicles.
legal_terms_s2_body2: Our website, marketing materials, and product descriptions explain the types of information a report may contain when such information exists in the sources we query (for example, mileage history, accident indicators, salvage or title-related flags, theft records, ownership history, specifications, or photos). These descriptions are illustrative of the service scope and are not a guarantee that every category, field, or record will be available for every vehicle.
legal_terms_s3_body: To access reports, you must create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You must provide accurate and complete information when registering. You are responsible for all activity that occurs under your account.
legal_terms_s4_body1: Reports are sold on a per-report basis. Payment is processed securely by PayPal. All prices are displayed inclusive of applicable taxes. Prices are subject to change with notice.
legal_terms_s4_refund_body: If we are unable to retrieve any reportable data for your requested VIN due to a technical failure on our part, you may be entitled to a full refund within 14 days of purchase, in accordance with our published refund rules. No refund is issued solely because a report contains limited, partial, or missing fields where data was not available from our providers, or because the report does not meet your expectations. A successfully generated and delivered report — including a report with sparse or incomplete sections — constitutes fulfillment of the Service for that purchase.
legal_terms_s5_title: 5. Accuracy, Completeness, and Availability of Information
legal_terms_s5_body0: kmcheck.com does not create vehicle history records. We collect and present data supplied by independent third-party providers, which may include auction platforms, insurance filings, marketplace listings, and similar commercial sources. We are not responsible for the accuracy, authenticity, or completeness of information provided by those sources.
legal_terms_s5_body1: Vehicle history data is supplied by third parties outside kmcheck's control. kmcheck does not warrant that any report will be complete, accurate, current, or free from error. Reports are provided on an "as available" and "as is" basis.
legal_terms_s5_body2: Data availability varies significantly from vehicle to vehicle. A report may include only a subset of the categories shown in our marketing or sample reports. Limited or missing information may result from factors including, without limitation:
legal_terms_s5_li1: Whether the vehicle's history was reported to insurers, auctions, marketplaces, or government agencies
legal_terms_s5_li2: Country or region of registration, export, import, or prior use
legal_terms_s5_li3: Vehicle age, mileage, or periods before digital record-keeping
legal_terms_s5_li4: Delays, gaps, or inconsistencies in third-party databases
legal_terms_s5_li5: Provider coverage limits, licensing restrictions, or source-specific rules
legal_terms_s5_li6: Privacy laws or data-retention policies that limit disclosure
legal_terms_s5_body3: The absence of a negative record (for example, no listed accident, salvage flag, or theft record) does not mean that no such event occurred. Conversely, a flagged record reflects what a source reported at a point in time and may require independent verification.
legal_terms_s5_body4: kmcheck reports are for informational purposes only. They do not constitute legal, mechanical, financial, or professional advice. You must not rely on a kmcheck report as the sole basis for a purchase, sale, financing, insurance, or safety decision. We strongly recommend an independent physical inspection, professional mechanic evaluation, and review of official documents before any transaction.
legal_terms_s6_li1: Use the Service for any unlawful purpose
legal_terms_s6_li2: Resell or redistribute reports without prior written consent
legal_terms_s6_li3: Attempt to reverse-engineer, scrape, or bulk-download our data
legal_terms_s6_li4: Use automated systems to access the Service without authorisation

Individual vehicle history data may be subject to the terms of our data providers. You may use reports for personal and commercial due diligence purposes only.
legal_terms_s8_body: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, kmcheck shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of the Service, including reliance on report data — whether complete, partial, missing, or outdated — in a vehicle purchase or other decision. Our total liability to you for any claim relating to the Service shall not exceed the amount paid by you for the specific report in question.
legal_terms_s9_body: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with applicable law. Any disputes shall be resolved in the competent courts of the jurisdiction in which kmcheck operates.
legal_terms_s10_body: For any questions regarding these Terms, please contact us at support@kmcheck.com.
legal_privacy_intro: Your privacy matters. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights.
legal_privacy_s1_account_body: Email address, name (optional), and a securely hashed password. Authentication is handled directly by kmcheck.com — we never share your credentials with third-party auth providers.
legal_privacy_s1_usage_body: VIN numbers you look up, report generation timestamps, payment records (amount, currency, PayPal transaction ID — we never store card numbers), IP address for abuse prevention.
legal_privacy_s1_technical_body: Browser type, device type, language preference, pages visited. We use this for analytics and service improvement.
legal_privacy_s2_li1: To create and manage your account
legal_privacy_s2_li3: To generate and deliver vehicle history reports
legal_privacy_s2_li4: To detect and prevent fraud and abuse
legal_privacy_s2_li5: To improve the platform and user experience
legal_privacy_s2_li6: To send transactional emails (report delivery, receipts)
legal_privacy_s2_footer: We do not sell your personal data to any third party. We do not use your data for advertising.
legal_privacy_s3_intro: We share minimal data with trusted service providers:
legal_privacy_s3_auth: kmcheck.com (self-hosted auth) — Authentication is handled directly on our servers. Your password is stored as a one-way bcrypt hash and is never transmitted in plain text.
legal_privacy_s3_paypal: PayPal — Payment processing. Subject to PCI-DSS compliance. We never see your card data.
legal_privacy_s3_providers: Data providers — We send VIN numbers to our vehicle history data providers to generate reports. No personal identifiers are sent. The content returned depends entirely on what each provider, insurer, marketplace, or registry holds for that VIN at the time of the query; kmcheck does not control those databases.
legal_privacy_s3_footer: Vehicle history information displayed in reports originates from third-party sources. Availability and completeness of that information vary by vehicle and jurisdiction. Our privacy practices govern how we handle your personal data; they do not expand or guarantee the scope of vehicle history data supplied by external providers.
legal_privacy_s4_body1: When you request a report, we query third-party data sources on your behalf. The categories of information we may present — such as mileage readings, accident-related records, salvage or title-related indicators, theft flags, ownership history, specifications, or photographs — depend on what those sources make available for the specific VIN.
legal_privacy_s4_body2: Some vehicles have extensive records; others have limited or no records in the databases we access. Marketing and sample reports on our site describe typical report capabilities when data exists; they are not a representation that every data point will be present for every vehicle. You acknowledge that report content is subject to the coverage, accuracy, and update practices of independent providers, not kmcheck.
legal_privacy_s5_body: We retain your account data for as long as your account is active. VIN lookup records are retained for 12 months for re-access and support purposes. You may request deletion of your data at any time (see Section 7).
legal_privacy_cookies_intro_before: This Cookie Policy explains how kmcheck uses cookies and similar technologies on our website. Cookies help us operate the platform (for example, keeping you signed in and remembering your language preference). They do not determine what vehicle history data appears in a report — report content comes from third-party data providers as described in our
legal_privacy_cookies_types: We use the following types of cookies:
legal_cookie_essential_desc: Session and authentication cookies required for the platform to function. Cannot be disabled.
legal_cookie_functional_desc: Language preference, theme preference (light/dark). These improve your experience.
legal_cookie_analytics_desc: Anonymous usage data to understand how users interact with the platform. No personal data is linked.
legal_privacy_s7_intro: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights:
legal_privacy_s7_access: Access — Request a copy of all data we hold about you
legal_privacy_s7_rectification: Rectification — Request correction of inaccurate data
legal_privacy_s7_erasure: Erasure — Request deletion of your personal data
legal_privacy_s7_portability: Portability — Request your data in a machine-readable format
legal_privacy_s7_objection: Objection — Object to processing of your data for certain purposes
legal_privacy_s7_footer_before: To exercise any of these rights, email privacy@kmcheck.com. We will respond within 30 days. For questions about report content or data availability, see our
legal_privacy_s8_body: We use industry-standard security measures including TLS encryption, secure self-hosted authentication, and PCI-compliant payment processing (PayPal). Access to personal data is restricted to authorised personnel only. We conduct regular security reviews.
legal_privacy_s9_body: The Service is not directed to children under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe we have inadvertently collected data from a child, please contact us immediately.
legal_privacy_s10_body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify registered users of material changes by email. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance.
legal_privacy_s11_body: For privacy-related requests, contact us at privacy@kmcheck.com.
